I went to the Archies shop in Mira Road to buy gifts, and after going there I was looking around at the items. While I was moving around, the staff kept walking right behind me. Wherever I went, they were following me. Being a customer, anyone would feel uncomfortable if three staff members are surrounding you while you’re shopping.

I asked them why they were standing around me like that, and one lady there got annoyed and rudely said, “You need help, that’s why.” I replied, “Yes, if I need help, I will ask for it, but if three staff members keep surrounding me, it becomes uncomfortable.”

Honestly, I had a very bad experience. Whatever the situation, customers should be given their own space, not constantly shadowed by staff—especially not three of them together. It was really very uncomfortable, and because of that I lost interest in buying anything. So, I just bought one small item and left the place.

I request the Archies shop owner to train your staff in proper customer service.

Student Creation Spotlight – Resin Pooja Thali Workshop in Mira Road, Mumbai 
This beautifully handcrafted Resin Pooja Thali was created by one of our students during our 2-Day Resin Art Workshop at Heartncraft. What makes this creation truly special is the perfect blend of spirituality, creativity, and functionality.

The thali features vibrant preserved flowers, delicate botanical elements, elegant pearl embellishments, luxurious gold accents, and a beautifully decorated Om symbol at its centre. Student Creation Spotlight – Luxury Geode Resin Clock

This elegant Resin Clock is a beautiful example of how creativity and resin art can come together to create a functional masterpiece. Designed and handcrafted by one of our students during our 2-Day Resin Art Workshop, this clock showcases a stunning blend of royal blue and marble ivory resin, enhanced with luxurious gold crystal accents and premium gold Roman numerals.

The flowing design creates the illusion of natural geode formations, where the shimmering gold textured lines beautifully separate the colours and add depth, richness, and sophistication to the artwork. The glossy finish enhances the marble effect, making every section unique and impossible to replicate exactly, which is the true beauty of handmade resin art.

What makes this creation even more special is that it was crafted by a student through step-by-step guidance during the workshop. From learning resin mixing ratios and colour blending techniques to creating geode effects, embedding decorative elements, and assembling the clock mechanism, every stage of the process helps students transform a simple base into a stunning piece of home décor.

This clock is not just a timepiece; it is a statement artwork that can enhance living rooms, offices, bedrooms, reception areas, and luxury interiors.
